description: Log up to 5 colour codes against an EXISTING order for the team (order_ref required; without it the tool returns status order_required and logs nothing). Free swatches: up to 3 colours of one product, ordered on the product page (Order free swatches). Swatches on their own: R145 courier (the swatches themselves are free), and we take the courier fee off their blind order within 30 days. Free with a blind. Ordered with a blind of the same product, the blind is made once the customer confirms the colour (keep it or pick one of the swatches, same price). On orders over R8,000 a wider variety is available if the customer asks for it, sent and collected at our cost. Not for the value ranges, bamboo or Vertishades. Off-cuts are not sent.

order_ref.description: The order reference the swatches ship with. Required.
